facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

control_failures.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on HT-9006

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on HT-9006 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9006 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 18 January 2024 a corrective action on HT-9006 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
